title: Hero story: animated clip → slices → composition explainer
description:
Replace the landing hero's decorative waveform with a slow animated story of what Apricity does, told with real data from examples/chop-shop.apr.

**Story:** the Thunderer drum stem appears → analysis sweep (beats, hits, BPM/key/tuning) → a hand-made slice → the slice projects to a chops row (16 half-beat chops) → the chops fly into the composition and warp to the 88 BPM grid. Then clip 1 collapses to a summary, and the horns stem goes through the same steps: 4 chops that land in bars 5–8 transposed to follow I7/IV7/V7. Full playback follows, with lineage glows (tile → chop → source span). About a 70 s loop, with a chapter bar (Listen · Slice · Chop · Warp · Tune · Play), pause on hover, and a static frame under reduced motion.

**Build:** a reusable renderer in web/src/ui/flow/ (model, layout, paint, tween, story). The data is baked by scripts/hero-data.py from the manifests plus the compiled timeline. The CTA becomes Hear "Chop Shop".

**Done when:** the data checks pass (peaks for both sources, 16 + 4 chops, every tile mapped, h transposed under IV7/V7); tsc passes; the browser check covers each chapter, light/dark, mobile and reduced motion; and Hear plays chop-shop.
